fill_model.note: AT-02: fill price equals the next KRX session raw open plus the configured slippage bps (buy: ask = open + slippage; sell: bid = open - slippage). The signal-day close and the execution day's high/low/close are never touched.

content.equity_note: Daily equity = cash + sum(position shares x session close); cash ledger debited/credited at fill prices.

content.note: Phase 0 gate runs a zero-fee model; the cost model lands in Todo 18.

content.history_depth_note: Seed history of 9 sessions; Todo 14 extends to 200+ sessions with the same synthetic generator contract.
content.purpose: Canonical seed dataset for T-close -> T+1-open semantics (AT-02), event ordering (Todo 13), and the Phase 0 golden run (Todo 14). Extended by later synthetic generators for history depth.
content.rights_note: Fabricated values only. No licensed KRX data, no real market payloads; real ticker codes are public identifiers used solely for universe shape.

content.holiday_note: The Seollal break and next_session_of mapping are encoded data properties: Todo 9 must build the real KRX calendar and agree with these values.
content.no_dst_note: Asia/Seoul has no DST; fixed +09:00 offset.

content.note: Canonical dataset has no corporate actions. Split/dividend behavior lives in tests/fixtures/kr-etf/variants/split-dividend/actions.json.

content.description: Machine-readable encoding of the documented T-close -> T+1-open execution model (requirements AT-02; design sections 6.5/17.2). A signal computed from the 2020-01-31 close must only fill at the next KRX session open, and must never touch that session's high/low/close.
